windows.agents.empty: No usage from Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode or GitHub Copilot yet. It appears here as soon as any of them works on this PC.
windows.agents.settingsDescription: Reads the usage Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and GitHub Copilot record on this PC and the plan limits the Claude app saves. Prompts, replies and files are never kept, and your usage never leaves your PC.
windows.agents.claudeLimitsTray: Claude checks your limits only while its icon is in the notification area. Turn the icon on in the Claude app settings, and your limits appear here within minutes.
windows.agents.claudeLimitsNoApp: Plan limits come from Claude Code or from the Claude app, which is not on this PC. Until then, the 5-hour session is estimated from Claude Code activity.
windows.agents.claudeLimitsPrivacy: Claude Code checks your account’s limits, including use on other machines, with its own sign-in, which Vorssaint never reads. No prompt is sent. When it cannot check, the percentages the Claude app saves on this PC are used.
windows.agents.claudeCodeMissing: Claude Code was not found on this PC.
windows.calendar.permission: Read your calendars to show upcoming appointments. Events stay on this PC.
windows.calendar.denied: Allow calendar access in Windows Settings to see your appointments.
windows.calendar.unavailableTitle: Calendar access is unavailable in this build
windows.calendar.unavailable: Reading your calendars needs the Vorssaint package the installer registers. Reinstall Vorssaint to add it, then open Calendar again.
windows.calendar.noCalendars: No calendars found. Windows shares the calendars of its Calendar app and classic Outlook; the new Outlook keeps its own.
windows.camera.cameraChangedButThePrefer: Camera changed, but the preference could not be saved.
windows.camera.cameraAccessWasDeniedAllo: Camera access was denied. Allow camera access for desktop apps in Windows Settings → Privacy & security → Camera, then try again.
windows.camera.thisCameraIsUnavailableCo: This camera is unavailable. Connect a camera or choose another one.
windows.camera.theCameraCouldNotStartItM: The camera could not start. It may be in use by another app. Close that app or choose another camera.
windows.camera.theCameraCouldNotStartChe: The camera could not start. Check its connection and try again.
windows.captures.screenshotsYouTakeWithV: Screenshots you take with Vorssaint will appear here.
windows.captures.savedScreenshotsStayInY: Saved screenshots stay in your Screenshots folder. Only history copies are removed.
windows.captures.perform.error: Could not open this capture. It may be missing or have no associated application.

notchClaudeSessions.question: Claude asks
windows.sessions.questionHint: Your answer goes straight to Claude. Enter sends what you wrote, and Ctrl+N skips the question.
windows.sessions.codexQuestionHint: Your answer goes straight to Codex. Enter sends what you wrote, and Ctrl+N skips the question.
windows.sessions.pasteImages: Alt+V / Ctrl+V to paste images, or drop them here
windows.sessions.replyUnavailable: Replies work in Windows Terminal and VS Code
notchClaudeSessions.replyWhileDialog: Close the dialog in the terminal first

notchClaudeSessions.previewsOffCodex: Turn on previews in Settings to see what Codex wrote.

notchClaudeSessions.sendWhileWaiting: It’s waiting on a prompt now. Answer it first.
windows.settings.redIndicatorsWhenYourMi: Red indicators when your microphone or Discord headphones are muted.
windows.settings.theAppToOpenWhenNothing: The app to open when nothing is playing. Automatic uses the last music app, then an installed player.
windows.settings.automaticMayFollowBrows: Automatic may follow browsers and other media apps. A manual source choice always takes priority.
windows.settings.installedPlayersCouldNo: Installed players could not be loaded. Active media sessions are still available.
windows.settings.mascot.switchCaption: A little friend in the Dynamic Island who says hello now and then and reacts to what happens on your PC.
notch.title: Dynamic Island
windows.settings.general.islandCaption: Your music, sessions and everyday tools, together at the top of your screen. Turn it off to hide the island.
windows.settings.general.loginCaption: Opens Vorssaint in the background when you sign in.
windows.settings.layout.sizeCaption: Width and maximum content height when you open the island.
windows.settings.layout.notchFitCaption: Resize the closed notch and shape its left and right extensions. Changes apply immediately with any size preset.
windows.settings.layout.cornersCaption: Rounder or sharper corners in both closed and expanded views. 100% is the default.
windows.settings.layout.notchPreview: Notch shape preview with highlighted side extensions
windows.settings.layout.notchPreviewCapt: The highlighted curves are the side extensions. Adjust both together below.
windows.settings.layout.shoulderWidthCap: Extend the curved shoulders to the left and right. 100% is the default.
windows.settings.layout.shoulderHeightCa: Make both curved shoulders thicker or thinner vertically. 100% is the default.
windows.settings.layout.shapeCaption: A notch hangs from the top edge. A capsule floats just below it.
windows.settings.layout.capsulePreviewCa: Preview of width, height, corner rounding and distance below the screen edge.
windows.settings.layout.capsuleFitCaptio: Resizes the capsule and lowers it from the top of the screen.
windows.settings.layout.outlineCaption: A thin light edge around the island, easier to see on dark wallpapers.
windows.settings.content.idleContentCapt: Choose what appears on the closed island. Hidden sections wait until enabled again; live activities and notices take priority.
windows.settings.content.downloadFolders: Downloads and browser download folders are monitored automatically. For other apps, add full folder paths, one per line. Changes save when you leave this field. File transfers in these folders are shown too; subfolders are not scanned.
windows.settings.content.quickPreviewCap: Click a circle to change its action. Use + to add another shortcut.
windows.settings.content.quickCapacity: Up to three circles on each side and three below the island. Changes apply immediately.
windows.settings.content.defaultShortcut: Restore the original five circles, their actions and positions.
windows.settings.content.shortcutCaption: Choose what the lower side circle opens. Changes apply immediately.
windows.settings.content.lead: Choose which sections the island shows and in what order. Each section keeps its own options.
windows.settings.content.comingSoon: This section is coming to Windows. Its options arrive with it.
windows.settings.content.showPlayingMusi: The song takes the closed island, with its cover and moving bars.
windows.settings.content.lyricsOnlineCap: While lyrics are open, send the song title, artist, album and duration to lrclib.net. Imported lyrics stay on this PC.
windows.settings.content.hideTimerCountd: A running timer stays off the closed island. A finished one still shows.
windows.settings.content.timerSoundCapti: A chime every 2 seconds, for up to 5 minutes, until you dismiss the timer.
windows.settings.content.watchSoundCapti: A chime when what you watch changes, finishes or shows what you are waiting for.
windows.settings.content.colorFormatCapt: How a picked color is copied.
windows.settings.content.quickTogglesCap: Choose the actions the Quick toggles tool lists, and their order.
windows.settings.content.ejectExcludedCa: “Eject all disks” skips these. Add a disk’s name or its drive letter, one per line. Changes save when you leave this field.
windows.settings.content.toolsGridCaptio: Hide and arrange the tools from the island: open Tools and use the tune button.
windows.settings.content.textSizeCaption: The size the whole pad draws at.
windows.settings.content.dragRevealCapti: A drag over the closed island shows where to drop. Off, it opens Files right away.
windows.settings.content.shelfCloseAfter: Closes the island when the destination accepts the items. Pinning the island keeps it open.
windows.settings.content.notificationsCa: Discord, Messenger and other desktop notifications show only the app icon, app name and sender. Message text is not collected or displayed. Discord’s Do Not Disturb and muted chats follow its desktop notification settings.
windows.settings.system.intervalCaption: How often the cards read while the System section is open. Nothing is measured while it's closed.
windows.settings.system.captions.connect: Count connected USB and Bluetooth devices
windows.settings.summaries.notifications: Your notifications, kept in the island.
windows.settings.summaries.agents: Plan limits, tokens and API value of Claude, Codex, OpenCode and GitHub Copilot.
notchClaudeSessions.summary: Running Claude Code and Codex sessions, and what each one needs from you.
windows.settings.activity.downloadProgre: Show a small download indicator across apps. Click it to see file names, progress and downloaded MB. Details never open automatically.
windows.settings.activity.indicatorsLead: Short notices the closed island shows when something changes.
windows.settings.activity.timerCountdown: The time left beside the camera while a timer runs. A finished timer always shows.
windows.settings.activity.trackChangeCap: The cover, title and artist for a moment when the song changes.
windows.settings.activity.more: The clipboard’s “Copied” notice is in Content › Clipboard.
windows.settings.activity.keepAwakeCapti: A running session shows in the closed island with the time it has left, or ∞ when it has no end.
windows.settings.activity.volumeCaption: The new level for a moment when it changes with the volume keys or from another app.
windows.settings.activity.agentsCaption: While Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode or GitHub Copilot works, its mark and the reading you chose beside the camera.
windows.settings.behavior.openingCaption: How the island opens from the top of the screen.
windows.settings.behavior.shortcutCaptio: Opens and closes the island from any app.
windows.settings.behavior.shortcutTaken: The configured shortcut is unavailable. Another app may be using it; record a different combination.
windows.settings.behavior.shortcutRecord: Press a key with Ctrl or Alt, then release it. Escape or a click elsewhere cancels.
windows.settings.behavior.shortcutInvali: Use Ctrl or Alt with a supported key. Windows system shortcuts and AltGr are unavailable.
windows.settings.behavior.reopeningCapti: Where the island opens the next time.
windows.settings.behavior.hideFullscreen: Hides while an app fills the whole screen, like a game or a film, and comes back after.
windows.settings.behavior.whereCaption: With several displays, which one has the island.
windows.settings.behavior.capturesCaptio: Off leaves the island out of screenshots, recordings and screen sharing.
windows.settings.sessions.lead: Reads the state Claude Code and Codex keep for each running session on this PC. Prompts and replies stay unread unless you turn on previews, and nothing leaves your PC.
windows.settings.sessions.claudeOnCaptio: Vorssaint hears every session through hooks in ~/.claude/settings.json.
windows.settings.sessions.claudeOffCapti: Install the hooks so the island sees Claude Code sessions and can answer their prompts. A backup of settings.json is made first.
windows.settings.sessions.bridgeCaption: Replies and Open for sessions in an editor's terminal go through a small extension included with Vorssaint. It shows a terminal or types into it only when you ask. If a window that's already open doesn't pick it up, reload it.
windows.settings.sessions.bridgeFailures: This editor is no longer on this PC.
The editor didn't accept the extension.
The editor took too long to answer. Try again.
windows.settings.sessions.codexCaption: Nothing to install. The island talks to the app server Codex runs while it's open.
notchClaudeSessions.contentPreviewHint: Shows titles, commands, file names and the conversation. They stay in memory and are cleared when you turn this off.
notchClaudeSessions.autoExpand: Open the island when a session needs you
notchClaudeSessions.autoExpandHint: It won’t replace a page you already have open.
windows.settings.sessions.liveCaption: The agent at work, and how many sessions are working, waiting or done.
windows.settings.sessions.buddiesCaption: Clawd for Claude Code, a little robot for Codex, each dressed at random. Click one on its session's page to change the outfit.
windows.settings.calendar.permission: Read your calendars to show upcoming appointments. Events stay on this PC.
windows.settings.calendar.unavailableCap: Reading calendars needs the Vorssaint package the installer registers. Reinstall Vorssaint to add it.
windows.settings.calendar.noCalendars: No calendars found. Windows shares the calendars of its Calendar app and classic Outlook; the new Outlook keeps its own.
windows.settings.controls.levelsCaption: The levels sit in the island's top row when they fit, else in a row below it.
windows.settings.controls.shortcutsCapti: Turn tiles on or off and move them. The island shows them in this order.
windows.settings.controls.brightnessSlid: Sets the brightness of this PC's screen, and of external displays that accept DDC/CI. Off shows a shortcut to this setting instead.
windows.settings.controls.keepAwakeForCa: How long the Keep awake tile keeps the PC and display from idling to sleep. Closing the lid or pressing the power button still sleeps it.
windows.settings.controls.hideInactiveCa: Lists only apps that play, are muted or are set off 100%.
windows.settings.controls.hiddenAppsCapt: Every app that plays shows in the mixer.
windows.settings.controls.mixerCaption: Per-app volume goes up to 100%. Choosing an output or microphone makes it the Windows default for every app.
windows.settings.clipboard.ignoredAppsCa: Nothing you copy in these apps is saved to the history. Enter each app's program name, one per line. Changes save when you leave this field.
windows.settings.clipboard.noticeCaption: Copied content stays private until you open the clipboard.
windows.settings.agents.cardsKeys: Alt+arrow keys move the focused card.
windows.settings.pausesWhileHoveredNever: Pauses while hovered. Never affects pinned screenshots.
windows.settings.dismissScreenshotPrevie: Dismiss screenshot preview on focus loss
windows.settings.afterClickingThePreview: After clicking the preview, switching to another app closes it. Pinned previews stay open.
windows.system.memoryPressureHelp: Windows approximation: the higher of physical RAM usage and commit-limit usage. This is not the macOS memory pressure measurement.
windows.system.memoryCompressedHelp: Resident RAM occupied by the Windows MemCompression store; not the original size of the pages before compression. Unavailable when Windows does not expose the store process.
windows.system.memoryCachedHelp: Windows system cache: standby list plus system working set. This differs from macOS Cached Files and Task Manager's Cached value.
windows.system.memorySwapUsedHelp: Current usage summed across Windows page files. This is not committed memory or the amount written to disk over time.
windows.system.processesUnavailable: Process metrics unavailable on this PC
windows.system.networkPermissionDenied: Showing which apps use the network needs an administrator account
windows.system.networkNeedsApproval: Windows asks an administrator once before showing which apps use the network
windows.system.networkDeclined: Windows didn't allow it. You can try again.
windows.system.networkIncomplete: Network events were lost. Measuring again…
windows.system.energyUnavailable: Per-app energy measurements unavailable on Windows
windows.system.powerUnavailable: Power metrics unavailable on this PC
windows.tools.noLanguageDetail: Add a language with OCR in Settings › Time & language
windows.tools.micMuteCaption: Cuts the microphone with a click, across every app.
windows.tools.emptyTrashCaption: Removes everything from the Recycle Bin.
windows.tools.emptyTrashConfirmMessage: All items in the Recycle Bin will be removed. This cannot be undone.
windows.tools.explorerCaption: Open File Explorer windows refresh to apply it.
windows.tools.lockScreenCaption: Asks for your PIN or password to come back.
windows.tools.displayOffCaption: The PC keeps running with the display off.
windows.tools.label: HEX
windows.watch.description: Turn any part of any window into a live activity in the island, with an alert when it changes, finishes or shows what you are waiting for.
windows.watch.permissionHint: Windows didn't let Vorssaint read this area. Watch reads it on this PC only; nothing leaves your PC.
windows.settings.languageCaption: Apply the language immediately in every window.
windows.preview.screenshotDiscardedClipb: Screenshot discarded. Clipboard contents are unchanged.
windows.preview.windowsShareOpenedPrevie: Windows Share opened. Preview pinned until you close it.
windows.preview.windowsShareIsUnavailabl: Windows Share is unavailable on this system. Drag the screenshot into another app instead.

windows.preview.noTextFoundInThisScreens: No text found in this screenshot
windows.preview.thisWindowDoesNotOwnTheS: This window does not own the screenshot

windows.settings.label: Until closed
windows.downloads.addFolderTitle: Choose a folder where downloads arrive
windows.settings.content.captureControls: Switch tools at the top of the screen while selecting. Keys 1 to 4 and R work either way.
windows.sessions.backgroundHelp: Runs in the background, with no terminal. Open attaches one.
windows.sessions.logsGone: A stopped session keeps no output. Open it to bring it back.
windows.sessions.stopConfirm: Stop this session? Its conversation is kept, and Open brings it back.
windows.sessions.removeConfirm: Remove this session for good? Claude Code deletes it, and its worktree when that’s safe.
windows.sessions.replyEnded: Open this session to continue it
windows.sessions.backgroundOffHelp: Agent View is off in Claude Code, so sessions can only start in a terminal.
windows.sessions.folderNotTrusted: Claude Code doesn’t trust this folder yet. Start it in a terminal once and say yes.
windows.sessions.backgroundNeedsPrompt: In the background, a session needs a first prompt.
windows.sessions.codexNotStarted: Codex’s background server didn’t start. Try Terminal.
